W1_minimal_contract.padding: Hardware canonicalizes beat0 high64 and beats1..3 to zero and actually writes/ACKs all4 A words; source nonzero padding ignored, never stale RAM.
W1_minimal_contract.input_complete: input_stored level/marker set only after8 ingress handshakes and8 actual ordinary S write ACKs with no pending input transaction; remains bound to this frame until done consumed/reset/abort.
W1_minimal_contract.start: start_ready only when current input_stored and native lifetimes safe; early pulse not queued; held valid may accept once ready. No input overwriting during RUN or pending DONE.
W1_minimal_contract.literal_init_must_change: Remove/replace P2 literal S_INIT write service with INPUT_STORED verification; it must not overwrite ingress data. Permanent program remains fixed; this is a source-design change for future RTL, not bootload.
W1_minimal_contract.S_owner: One ordinary helper owns ingress writes and all RUN result writes/reads; no direct second writer.
W1_minimal_contract.M_rule: CLEAR/SET_SCALE ACK then loader complete then EXEC status inspected; only op3 payloads are results, 4 sequential pairs saved to S with ACK.
W1_minimal_contract.T_rule: BEGIN4 owner0 generation1,4 ordered result words,COMMIT,real consumer takes,index0..3,last only3,then RELEASE before task success.
W1_minimal_contract.output_completion: Preserve P2 data/index/last under backpressure; stable done_valid/done_error until consumed; input_stored not compute done, last not release/job done.

reset_abort.hard_reset: invalidate frame/counts/lifetimes/completion coherently, not RAM rollback; no invented done for interrupted accepted run
reset_abort.abort_before_start: discard incomplete/complete-not-started frame and clear input_stored; no task completion because no start accepted
reset_abort.abort_RUN: coordinated leaf/helper reset plus one retained error completion, already consumed external prefix not retracted
reset_abort.abort_existing_DONE: keep existing done result; ready may consume it once; no duplicate
reset_abort.reuse: after done consumed accept a wholly new8beat frame; never reuse old complete marker
